verdict.rationale: windmill-docs-21 explicitly documents AI-driven editing of scripts/flows/apps followed by a review-and-deploy step, and windmill-docs-20 shows AI agent steps can be embedded in flows, indicating genuine natural-language generation/editing support. However, evidence is purely first-party docs with no independent/hands-on corroboration of prompt-to-workflow quality or reliability. Missing for 10: independent/community validation of AI-generated flow quality, details on scope/limits of NL-to-workflow generation, and confirmation this works for full flow creation (not just editing existing items).
